content: डम्बरः {%a.%} Famous, renowned. .{@-रः@} .²1 An assemblage, collection, mass; <ls>Māl. 9. 16</ls>. .²2 Show, pomp. .²3 Resemblance, likeness, appearance; <ls>U. 6. 17</ls>; <ls>Māl. 3. 7</ls>. .²4 Pride, arrogance. .²5 A great noise, loud assertion, verbosity; आविर्भावडम्बरं कृत्वा <ls>Ks. 107. 5</ls>. .²6 Beauty.
